# Mermaid

`mermaid-10.9.5.min.js` is the unmodified Mermaid 10.9.5 UMD distribution,
downloaded from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/mermaid@10.9.5/dist/mermaid.min.js.
Its MIT license is included in `mermaid-LICENSE`.

The site previously loaded Mermaid 10 from jsDelivr. Keeping this pinned copy
local makes rendering independent of the CDN. Load it before `diagrams.js`.
